title: Recreating the School part of Mall World
content: In my Mallworld there is a school attached where there is tons of partying and teachers asking for you to give reports and people get upset if you tell them it's just a dream. Always there is a rush to get your stuff together to get on a bus or airplane, usually you will have to hang on for dear life to the wings! Does anyone else experience this? Check out this accurate recreation- [https://youtube.com/shorts/V3Crf2tAhqo?si=TUUk5juHN4Z47EKc](https://youtube.com/shorts/V3Crf2tAhqo?si=TUUk5juHN4Z47EKc)
